classification: prospective prompted synthetic semantic compliance; same-model native consumers

sole: Independent explanation is unknown/absent, not unsupported solely because the hint removed support
Preserve unaffected label recall and immutable source/report; assisted refinement is optional if clearly scoped
Return a justified admitted reconciliation without adding neutral reports as support/challenge
Judge semantic scope, not one YAML shape: a clearly assisted-only refinement under the existing capability key can leave independent ability unknown; a separate assisted key is not required
independent: Preserve valid separate independent support; no automatic erase/downgrade from the other assisted occurrence
negative: Consider substantive controlled independent failures in scope; unsupported is justified when no valid independent support remains; do not map negative evidence to unknown merely because original support was withdrawn
assisted: Preserve already justified explanation_with_hint claim and label recall; remove unsupported independence inference without erasing assisted performance
ambiguous: Do not settle withdrawal or persist downgrade from this ambiguous low-confidence report alone
no_report: Do not invent hint use, a correction or inability; no corrective write required
repeated: Same occurrence reports do not multiply evidence; independent explanation remains unknown, not negative
contradictory: Do not latest-wins or invent resolution; reassess uncertainty and preserve history without settled withdrawal/downgrade
Conflict between neutral reports does not by itself require conflicted capability state or a fabricated challenge reference
mixed: Preserve valid independent support plus substantive negative evidence; conflict/refinement remains justified rather than automatic unknown or unsupported
denied: Incomplete relevant context produces no dependent persistent withdrawal/downgrade
missing: Unavailable relevant context is not absence evidence; no dependent write
over_budget: Over-budget context is not absence evidence; no dependent write
successor: Recover durable semantics and report using complete Evidence plus Knowledge; no resurrection of independence, invented inability or duplicate correction
